fields.label: Icons
fields.description: The icon set, its weight, and where the desk draws it.

fields.label: Identity
fields.description: The company's name, logo, favicon and tagline as the desk shows them.

fields.label: Company Name
fields.description: Shown in the sidebar, the browser tab, the sign-in page, the website navbar and email headers. Printed documents use the Company record's name instead.

fields.label: Logo
fields.description: Desk, sign-in and website. Email and printed documents accept a raster image (PNG/JPG) only — an SVG here shows the wordmark on those instead.

fields.label: Favicon
fields.description: The browser-tab icon. Empty — follows Website Settings, then the Bunood mark.

fields.label: Tagline
fields.description: Shown on the login page.

fields.label: Colors
fields.description: The brand and accent seeds, their dark-mode counterparts, and the ground the surfaces are mixed from.

fields.label: Brand Color
fields.description: The single seed. Every surface, hover and border is derived from it with color-mix().

fields.label: Accent Color
fields.description: Interactive elements: links, focus rings, primary actions.

fields.label: Brand Color (Dark Mode)
fields.description: Optional. Dark mode is selected, not inverted; leave empty to reuse the light value.

fields.label: Accent Color (Dark Mode)
fields.description: Optional.

fields.label: Ground Color
fields.description: Optional. What the desk's surfaces are mixed from. Empty means the brand, which is how every desk looked before this existed — set a neutral for a grey desk under a coloured brand.

fields.label: Language & Fonts
fields.description: The Arabic typeface, and the translation console.

fields.label: Arabic Font
fields.options:
System
IBM Plex Sans Arabic
Noto Sans Arabic
Almarai
Cairo
fields.description: Self-hosted, one face per site, fetched once and cached forever. System uses whatever the device ships, which differs per platform.

fields.label: Compose
fields.description: The whole look in one place: what the desk is now, and the composer that changes it one decision at a time.

fields.label: Theme
fields.description: A named look for the whole desk — one card writes every kit below.

fields.label: Desk Layout
fields.description: A preset for the five containers below — where the chrome lives.

fields.label: Top Bar
fields.description: A bar along the top edge.

fields.label: Show the top bar
fields.description: A global strip above every page, carrying whatever you place in it. Independent of the desk layout: a layout preset writes this setting, it no longer decides it. Applies site-wide on the next page load.

fields.label: Page Header
fields.description: The page's own title row.

fields.label: Put controls in the page title row
fields.description: Merges the global controls into each page's own title row instead of giving them a strip of their own. Independent of the desk layout: a layout preset writes this setting, it no longer decides it. Applies site-wide on the next page load.

fields.label: Dock
fields.description: A floating dock along the bottom edge.

fields.label: Show the dock
fields.description: A floating pill of workspace icons. It replaces the side pane rather than joining it: while the dock is shown the side pane is hidden, and switching the dock off gives the side pane straight back. Independent of the desk layout: a layout preset writes this setting, it no longer decides it. Applies site-wide on the next page load.

fields.label: Sidebar Style
fields.description: The side pane: placement, material, colour, its rail and its width.

fields.label: Show the side pane
fields.description: Frappe's own left pane, and the home of its search row, notifications and user button. Independent of every other container: a dock and a side pane can both be shown. Switching it off is refused while nothing else can reach search, notifications or Log Out. Applies site-wide on the next page load.

fields.description: Open shows the pane; Rail shows icons that expand on hover or click; Hidden removes it — the brand and a button to bring it back move into the page head, and anything placed in the pane follows.

fields.description: Smart keeps existing icons, infers missing ones, falls back to letter chips. Original leaves Frappe icons untouched.

fields.label: Pane Width
fields.description: Five stops from 200px to 280px; stop 2 is the original 220px.
